title: The Glue on the Paper Lantern Seam
youtube_title: The Glue on the Paper Lantern Seam | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Golda wants to check on a paper lantern seam that had to dry shut before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Golda leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
